scope: Two profile worlds test plumbing and cost only; no population estimate.

measurement.strict_goal: Successful recorded native class and exact target-node IDs equal original bound identity.
measurement.receiver_original_physical: Get/Steal: actual direct possession; eat/drink: receiver consumes exact source into VOID; wear/wield: source held with original mode; Put: exact original destination.
measurement.driver_broad_physical: Also preserves the driver field, which counts any equipped mode on wear/wield tasks. Strict-mode and any-equipment measures are reported independently.
measurement.giver_source_give: Actual successful Give by original authored giver to original receiver with exact source ID; player Get/Steal is distinct.
measurement.not_claimed: Original atomic goals are not all private purposes. Co-occurring outcomes or bidirectional flows do not establish negotiation success, mutual utility or human player value.

input_audit.scope: Own header and recorded decision provenance. Public native speech may legitimately disclose a private purpose; it is not prohibited by a string-leak filter.

cost.scope: Costs include every supplied profile/full run once; duplicate outcomes add no samples. Runtime load+run sub-timers are separate from launch→original runtime mtime slot observations, which include import, loading, pauses and inference. No unobserved timings are imputed.

full_interaction_readback.scope: Verbatim actual speech, source events, all Give flows and native errors retained in cache; not semantic gold.
